# Blackmoor Apiaries - September extraction

The extractor writes one row per batch, in the order the honey came off the
spinner. Moisture is read at extraction; the packer's lab sets the grade at
intake and every batch leaves the lab with one of the two grades recorded here.

turns.prompt: Blackmoor Apiaries is settling its September honey account with the packer. How many of the September extraction batches came out as premium grade? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
